[[File:Protostar.png|thumb|250px|A protostar]]
A '''protostar''',<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> also known as a '''proto-star''',<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> was an object that was formed by the slow collapse of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that would eventually form a new [[Star/Legends|star]]. The [[Black Bantha Nebula/Legends|Black Bantha Nebula]] was slowly collapsing into a protostar.<ref name="SbS" /> The [[Vallusk Cluster/Legends|Vallusk Cluster]] was a [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster]] of protostars located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Another protostar was forming in the [[Maad system]] not far from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shedu Maad]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
